name: High Priest Rohan
summary: In Ironforge, High Priest Rohan guides the Church of the Holy Light from the Hall of Mysteries. He teaches young priests, helps them deepen their mastery of the Light, and keeps spiritual ties between Ironforge, Stormwind, and distant allies.

sections.title: Shepherd of the Hall of Mysteries
sections.body: High Priest Rohan paces the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward as the Church of the Holy Light’s highest-ranking representative in the city. Dwarves once honored the titans, yet their priests have embraced the Light’s wisdom, compassion, and justice. Rohan patiently teaches young acolytes to channel holy magic and steel their minds against despair.

sections.title: Bridges Across the Alliance
sections.body: After priests under his care master the fundamentals, Rohan sends them abroad to learn from other traditions. Human and dwarven students go to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind City. Night elf disciples travel to Priestess Alathea at Darnassus’s Temple of the Moon to study mysteries such as Elune’s Grace. Rohan also sends healers to aid the Cenarion Circle’s druids in distant Azshara, wherever hardship calls.

sections.title: The Exorcism Censer
sections.body: Rohan keeps sacred relics for the Alliance priesthood and paladin brotherhoods. One is a blessed exorcism censer, used for years to cleanse vile spirits. When the Order of the Silver Hand and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker need it for their knights’ holy calling, Rohan lends it freely. He asks only for charitable alms to replenish Ironforge’s dwindling food reserves for the needy.

faq.q: Where can I find High Priest Rohan?
faq.answer: Find High Priest Rohan pacing inside the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward, on the city’s northern side. He walks between the holy library and the altar.

faq.q: What role does Rohan serve in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Rohan trains new priests, offers spiritual counsel, and directs them to advanced study across Azeroth. He is Ironforge’s senior priest trainer and the leading dwarven representative of the Church of the Holy Light in Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Why does Rohan send priests to Darnassus or Stormwind?
faq.answer: Rohan sends human and dwarven initiates to Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light to learn prayers such as Desperate Prayer. Night elf priests return to Darnassus’s Temple of the Moon to attune with Elune’s Grace. He believes spiritual growth draws on diverse traditions.

faq.q: Why do paladins seek out Rohan?
faq.answer: Paladins sent by Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker seek Rohan’s blessed exorcism censer. He lends the relic for the Order of the Silver Hand’s rites and asks for a modest donation of supplies to feed Ironforge’s poor.

faq.q: Why does Rohan send priests to Azshara?
faq.answer: Rohan sends healers to aid the Cenarion Circle’s night elf druids working in Azshara’s wild lands. He follows the Light’s call to charity and service.
Rohan guides Alliance devotees of many races, including dwarves, humans, and night elves. His early instruction prepares them to study with mentors who know their traditions.

angles.text: As a priest, Rohan’s guidance and early training are essential. He later directs you to renowned mentors in Stormwind or Darnassus, where you can learn racial devotions.
As a paladin sent by Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, you visit Rohan to borrow his exorcism censer. In return, you bring aid for Ironforge’s needy.
As a dwarf, you can see Rohan’s devotion to the Holy Light. The people of Khaz Modan hold deep spiritual conviction alongside their titan heritage.
As an Alliance devotee, you can see Rohan keep Ironforge’s clergy connected with the Cathedral of Light, the Temple of the Moon, and the Cenarion Circle.
